attributes.name: Karsos
attributes.powers:
Karsos is immune to the Mental and Poison traits. If the check to defeat does not have the Magic trait, Karsos is undefeated.

Before you act, if this is your first exploration of the turn, Karsos deals 1d4-1 Combat damage to you.

If undefeated, summon and build the location Maze and move there.
